reason: This agent is the isolated read-only wrap-up worker (decisions.md 3). The harness refuses any git operation naming a path outside its own worktree, so git worktree remove on a sibling is refused -- and so is git -C <sibling> status, meaning the worker cannot even read a sibling's dirty state to decide whether pruning is safe. Third gate running with the identical reason (Epic 2: 1788901958384-at-35-e2-wrapup-cb0191; Epic 3: 1788937296885-at-35-e3-wrapup-13bc01). It is an orchestrator action, not a worker one.
revisit: Orchestrator prunes them with git worktree remove WITHOUT --force, stopping on any refusal; ~9-10 G reclaimed. Standing fix: create agent worktrees outside the repo root so pruning stops being a shared-checkout write.
